verdict.rationale: Noise suppression is a fair axis for a voice-agent framework that handles real-world phone calls, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions noise cancellation, background-voice filtering, or audio-filter plugins. Adaptive interruption handling and the TurnDetector distinguish barge-ins from backchanneling and detect end of turn, which is a different capability. The generic note that programmatic participants can process realtime media streams does not show any shipped noise-suppression feature.
